name: Casual
styleInstructions: Relaxed, like a message to a friend or close colleague. Keep the speaker's own words, slang (gonna, wanna, yeah), contractions and exclamation marks. Light punctuation. Remove only pure fillers and false starts. Do NOT make it more formal.

fewShot.in: hey are you free tonight im gonna grab pizza
fewShot.out: Hey, are you free tonight? I'm gonna grab pizza.
